name: GigaSpeech: Multi-Domain ASR Corpus
description: GigaSpeech is an evolving, multi-domain English speech recognition corpus comprising 10,000 hours of high-quality transcribed audio and 33,000 hours of total audio. Sourced from audiobooks, podcasts, and YouTube across diverse topics, speaking styles, and acoustic environments.
